note: Every figure this project takes from Choi, Liu and Liu (2025) or from the spreadsheet guide, with where it comes from. Checked against the paper text and the guide on 7 September 2026. Part 6 of tools/verify_model.py holds the model and the methodology to these, so a number cannot drift back without failing. Values are exactly as the sources state them.

sources.paper: Choi, J. J., Liu, C. and Liu, P. (2025). Practical Finance: An Approximate Solution to Lifecycle Portfolio Choice. 7 November 2025. NBER working paper 34166.
sources.guide: Practical finance spreadsheet guide, the document the workbook's instructions point to.
sources.workbook: Chai - Yale.xlsx, tabs Disclaimer, Full inputs and Wage imputed.

calibration.stock_volatility_definition: annualized standard deviation of the CRSP value-weighted market index log monthly return in excess of the 1-month Treasury log return, July 1926 to July 2024
calibration.mortality: 2019 life table for the total U.S. population, National Center for Health Statistics

wage_discount_coefficients.where: paper Table 1, third column, ages 22 to 65

benefit_discount_coefficients.where: paper Table 2, third column, ages 66 to 99

welfare_losses.where: paper Table 4, from the perspective of a 22-year-old

labour_income_equity_correlation.source: Wuthenow (2024), Panel Study of Income Dynamics, 1980 to 2020, average household

replacement_rate_range.source: Biggs and Springstead (2008), median Social Security benefit as a percent of average inflation-adjusted labor income over the final five years before claiming
replacement_rate_range.note: 40% is the highest lifetime earnings quintile, 82% the second lowest

aqr_forecast.description: log excess return over cash for U.S. large-cap equities, year-end 2023, from dividend and payout discount models
aqr_forecast.source: Portfolio Solutions Group (2024), AQR Capital Management

realized_log_premium.description: log equity premium realized July 1926 to July 2024

guide.expected_return_description: your best guess of the average return of the stock market over your lifetime in excess of the inflation rate
guide.expected_return_justification: roughly equal to what is implied by current stock market valuation ratios if those ratios stay constant and future dividend or earnings growth equals its long-run historical average
guide.education_assumption: human capital of each adult has riskiness comparable to the average for college graduates
